deviations: App shell axes are sidebar expanded|collapsed|none x breakpoint desktop|tablet|mobile (9) per the brief, not the spec's layout dashboard|chat|docs: the chat and docs layouts need Message scroller, Prompt input (AI) and Toc (Docs kit), which do not exist yet. The spec's nav prop is sidebar=none; rail is a bool with a railContent swap on desktop.
Tablet follows the code's .ns-dashboard rule (sidebar becomes a sheet at <=1024 px), so tablet and mobile use Top bar breakpoint=mobile and a 280 px sheet (code width; overrides space/sidebar/width).

The mobile and tablet sheet is the Sidebar instance over a surface/overlay sidebar-backdrop (R.scrim), not a nested Sheet: Sheet's fixed 960x640 viewport and its own header would double the Sidebar header.

Page header: intro gap space/stack/gap, but section gap and bottom padding space/section/gap (spec says space/stack/gap; code spaces sections by space-5). Breadcrumb defaults off because the Top bar already carries one. Mobile hides the last tab and the second status meta to avoid overflow. The primary action glyph is rebound to primary/fg (see base defects).

Stats grid: columns=3 variants are W 1170 so thirds land on whole pixels; the joined strip draws its outer border on T/R/B and every card carries a border/width left divider (equal FILL widths); joined cards override pad-x to space/card/padding and radius to 0.

Detail layout adds aside panel|sheet (brief: nests a Sheet or side panel), so 4 variants instead of the spec's 2. Panel aside W 320 (spec); Sheet aside W 400 (Sheet's own width; 320 clipped its footer). Mobile bottom Sheet's content frame is overridden to FILL because the base Sheet bottom is fixed at 960.

Filter form: gap space/section/gap (spec space/stack/gap; code space-4 = 16). Added an active-filters row (Badge subtle with remove, Button xs link Clear all): the Card body keeps a 96 min-height that cannot be overridden on an instance, which left a 38 px void under the inline row.
Panel: section padding space/card/padding (spec space/stack/gap = 8; code space-4/space-5). Raised adds a border/subtle hairline because Utility card shadows resolve to 0. Footer fill card/footer.

Resizable handle: grip glyph is 10 px (shadcn size-2.5) instead of I.sm 14, which does not fit a 12 px grip; grip offset -6 keeps edges whole (0.5 px off-centre on the 1 px line); hover border/strong (spec silent). Resizable start panel carries a fixed default size (280 / 160) instead of 50/50 so edges stay whole.

Scroll area adds a radius/card + border/default frame (shadcn demo). Content hugs with min 480/640; components with a fixed width (Table) are squeezed to the min because Figma cannot hug a fixed-width instance, so the review demos a Tabs list for horizontal scroll.
Section divider: the line part is a type/label/line-tall frame with a 1 px rule at y 8 (whole pixels), W 481.
Aspect ratio W 336 so all four heights are whole pixels; the review's image row uses .Item image, a 40 px avatar stand-in that pixelates when scaled.

Direction (RTL) is documented on the Layout & blocks page (review frame with mirrored-prop pairs) instead of a Foundations specimen, so Foundations stays untouched; Breadcrumb and Sidebar mirroring is described, not drawn.
New private set .Page content (example App shell body), not in the spec.
baseDefectsFound: Button primary (Actions): after an iconStartGlyph/iconEndGlyph swap the glyph stroke stays text/fg, so the icon disappears on the ink fill in Utility light (the Dashboard screen's 'Create order' plus is missing in light). Same cause as the Filigrane/Button note. Worked around inside Page header only.
Card (Data display): the body content min-height (96/72) cannot be overridden on instances, so short swapped bodies leave a gap.
Sheet side=bottom (Overlays): the content frame is fixed at 960, so resizing the instance does not reflow.
Table (Data display): fixed width; below ~900 px the Customer and Status columns overlap (the Date column is hidden in .Page content and the Detail layout review).
Sidebar header toggle keeps panel-left inside the mobile sheet (a close glyph would read better).
ownerNotesApplied: Utility look: ink chrome (Top bar, Sidebar, primary actions), semantic content colour (status indicator, deltas, badges); red only in the logo and destructive deltas.
Dark is designed: every review renders the same instances under Scheme Dark (graphite primary, deep-tone badges, sheet over a darker scrim).
